insights.title: Cold Brew was not sold as much as expected
insights.recommendation: Find out what stopped Cold Brew from selling (2026-09-04 to 2026-09-08) and set up a backup so regulars can still get it next time. Total sales held up: about normal (5% above the usual level).
insights.summary: Cold Brew sold 0 instead of about 74 over 5 days (2026-09-04 to 2026-09-08), about $333.00 less Cold Brew revenue. But total sales were about normal ($2,702.35 vs about $2,584.85 expected): customers ordered other items instead (a little more of everything else), so this was not money the cafe lost.

insights.title: Fewest orders arrive during 2pm–4pm
insights.recommendation: Schedule prep, cleaning and breaks during 2pm–4pm (6.4 orders a day), and have the most staff on at 8am–10am (23.6 orders a day).
insights.summary: Over the last 4 weeks, 2pm–4pm was the quietest stretch: 6.4 orders a day (9% of the day's orders), vs 23.6 a day at 8am–10am, the busiest.

insights.title: Pastries sell more before 11am
insights.recommendation: Have most pastries baked and out before 11am: 59% of pastries sell by then. Keep Chocolate Chip Cookie stocked after lunch: 28% of its sales come after 2pm.
insights.summary: 59% of pastries sell before 11am, when 55% of orders come in. Chocolate Chip Cookie is the afternoon pastry: 28% of it sells after 2pm.
